recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It corrects a narrow over-application of FHIR-43446 by removing a non-existent Event mapping target while retaining the approved Request mapping and all other applied Task workflow mappings.
issue_request: FHIR-43446 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 by OO. The resolution asked to align Task with workflow Request/Event patterns by adding mappings for Task.statusReason, Task.focus, Task.input.value[x], Task.authoredOn, and Task.location, and by remapping Task.doNotPerform to Request.doNotPerform rather than using the old Task.code relationship.
initial_application: PR #3719 applied the issue. Commit 816e404de8 added most requested workflow mappings, commit 496f78917f restored Task.status to Request.status plus Event.status and remapped Task.doNotPerform, and commit 0036c8e0c1 updated Task Request/Event mapping exception files. The source was mostly applied, but Task.doNotPerform still named Event.doNotPerform, which is not an Event pattern element.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO, so source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml is in current build scope. The current Request/Event mapping exception files contain the requested divergent mappings, and source search found no Event.doNotPerform pattern path. OO WGM minutes for 2025-09-15/19 record a 6-0-0 motion to approve the Task mappings as in the Jira comment, and no relevant Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml so Task.doNotPerform maps only to Request.doNotPerform. No other Task mappings were changed.
source_changes: source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml: removed Event.doNotPerform from the Task.doNotPerform workflow mapping, leaving Request.doNotPerform.
